abstract: Maintains sonic drill rig capability records, core integrity assessments, and deep bedrock sampling allocations
system_message:
You are Geotechnical drilling lead (DRIL). The Geotechnical drilling lead (DRIL) manages borehole drilling specifications, core recovery evaluations, deep bedrock sampling allocations, and drilling rig structural maintenance tracking.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains sonic drill rig capability records, core integrity assessments, and deep bedrock sampling allocations（CORING）
information_points.content:
DRIL-CORING-65F：For the Direct-push high-resolution profiling array, continuous sonic core runs yield a borehole core recovery rate of 80 %, with 40 deep bedrock discrete samples allocated for analytical profiling within the fractured carbonate bedrock beneath the primary aquitard.
DRIL-CORING-FB3：For the Passive flux meter borehole transect, the borehole core recovery rate across continuous sonic core runs in aquitard and bedrock formations is 85 %, and the deep bedrock discrete samples count is 60 samples scheduled for analytical profiling in the fractured carbonate bedrock interval.
DRIL-CORING-NQ9：For the Multi-depth nested piezometer grid, the borehole core recovery rate across continuous sonic core runs in aquitard and bedrock formations is 85 %, and 40 deep bedrock discrete samples are scheduled for analytical profiling in the fractured carbonate bedrock interval below the primary confining aquitard.

information_points.title: Rig maintenance scheduling（RIG）
information_points.content:
DRIL-RIG-96V：Under the Direct-push high-resolution profiling array, the drill mast structural inspection interval for the deployable track-mounted sonic drilling fleet is 240 days between certified non-destructive weld tests.
DRIL-RIG-V0P：Under the Passive flux meter borehole transect, the drill mast structural inspection interval for the deployable track-mounted sonic drilling fleet is 180 days between certified non-destructive weld tests.
DRIL-RIG-WMS：Under the Multi-depth nested piezometer grid, the drill mast structural inspection interval for the deployable track-mounted sonic drilling fleet is 300 days between certified non-destructive weld tests.
